question: Nehru Institute of Mountaineering is located at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nehru Institute of Mountaineering** is located in **Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand**.
 
• It was established in **1965** to honor the **memory of India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru**, who was an ardent mountain lover.
 
• The institute offers various courses in mountaineering, including Basic, Advanced, and Method of Instruction courses, as well as specialized courses like Search and Rescue.
 
• It is one of the premier mountaineering institutes in India, along with the **Himalayan Mountaineering Institute in Darjeeling**.
 
• The institute aims to promote mountaineering as a sport and to inculcate the spirit of adventure among the youth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Uttarakhand, often referred to as the "**Land of the Gods**," is known for its natural beauty and is a popular destination for trekking and mountaineering.
 
• The state is home to several other important mountaineering and adventure sports institutes, including the** Indian Military Academy** in Dehradun.
 
• Uttarakhand is also famous for its pilgrimage sites, such as Haridwar, Rishikesh, and the Char Dham (Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, and Yamunotri).
